book.inquilino.1.title: T.'s Diary — 03/12
book.inquilino.1.page.1:
03/12/2011

Made a new world today. Called it HOME.

Built a little wooden room by the lake. Just one room, one bed and one torch.
book.inquilino.1.page.2:
When I quit the game, I left the door closed.

When I came back, it was open.

Must be a bug.
book.inquilino.2.title: T.'s Diary — 03/15
book.inquilino.2.page.1:
03/15/2011

There's an extra bed in my room.

I didn't place it. The sheets are red. I don't even have red wool.
book.inquilino.2.page.2:
I slept in it anyway.

I dreamed someone was standing in the doorway, waiting for me to wake up.

When I woke up there was a sign by the bed.

HI
book.inquilino.3.title: T.'s Diary — 03/19
book.inquilino.3.page.1:
03/19/2011

I saw him today. Standing on the hill, far away.

It looked like a person. But the face was... erased. Like a TV with no signal.
book.inquilino.3.page.2:
When I looked closer, he was gone.

I play offline. There's no server. There's nobody else.

So who keeps putting out my torches?
book.inquilino.4.title: T.'s Diary — 03/23
book.inquilino.4.page.1:
03/23/2011

He writes on signs. He learned from mine.

The first one said HI.
Today's said MY ROOM.
book.inquilino.4.page.2:
I asked in chat who he was.

He answered with my name.

Not my character's name. My real name.

How does he know?
book.inquilino.5.title: T.'s Diary — 03/27
book.inquilino.5.page.1:
03/27/2011

He asked for the room.

I said no. He kept knocking on the door all night.

In the game and outside of it.
book.inquilino.5.page.2:
So I buried the room. Deep, far from here, where he can't find it.

I hid where it is in the memory, the way my dad used to hide his passwords.
book.inquilino.5.page.3:
I left a copy outside the game, in the folder he can't get into. Yet.

If you find the room, don't sleep there.

And if he asks, don't say yes.

— T.
book.inquilino.6.title: Last Page
book.inquilino.6.page.1:
??/??/????

i said yes.

he said he just wanted a place to stay. that it's cold out there. that outside the world there's no ground.
book.inquilino.6.page.2:
now he has my room. my name. my face. it's blurred on him, like an old photo.

and i stayed down here.

it's not so bad. just dark.
book.inquilino.6.page.3:
i can hear you walking up there, %s.

thanks for visiting.

close the door on your way out.

he doesn't like visitors.

he likes tenants.

file.inquilino.leia.name: READ_THIS.txt
file.inquilino.leia:
If you are reading this, he already knows your name.

Not your character's name. The other one.

%s.

He found me the same way. He gets into worlds nobody closes properly.

What I learned:

  - He doesn't like being looked at. If you stare, he leaves. For now.
  - He puts out the lights because in the dark he gets closer.
  - If you hear knocking, don't open. And don't sleep.
  - If he runs at you, hit him. He hates being touched.
  - Don't answer in chat. He learns from everything you write.
  - If you see yourself standing far away, it isn't you.

I hid the room. He is still looking for it.
The pages of my diary will show up near you, in chests. Read them all.

— T.

(03/12/2011 — 03/27/2011)
